SHORT-SIDE AND MARKET CONTEXT FIELDS (added Nov 22, written by the nightly task's PART S from 23 Nov). DATA ONLY: recorded for later testing; they do not change the test protocol n20261121protocol or any alert. Written on every row of every scans doc dated the same day.

Borrow (source: IBorrowDesk, which publishes IBKR's own stock-loan feed; www.iborrowdesk.com/api/ticker/TICKER): bFeeOpen, bFeeHigh, bFee = annualised borrow fee % (open, high, last of the day); bAvailOpen, bAvailLow, bAvail = shares available to short at IBKR (open, low, last); bFeeAtScan, bAvailAtScan = latest ~15-minute snapshot at or before that row's doc ts_utc; bAvailZeroAt_utc = first snapshot of the day with 0 shares available; bNote when missing or stale.
Short interest (source: Finviz quote page, FINRA data published twice a month, so it lags): siPct = short float %, sr = short ratio (days to cover), siNote, siSrc.
Reg SHO threshold list (source: Nasdaq Trader daily file nasdaqthYYYYMMDD.txt; Nasdaq-listed names only): regSHO true/false, regSHOdays = consecutive trading days on the list (up to 10), regSHODate if the day's file was not yet posted, regSHONote for NYSE names not checked.
Options (source: IBKR snapshot): optVol = today's call+put volume on the underlying, optVolAvg = average; null with optNote 'no listed options'.
shortAsOf_utc = when read.

Market day docs (collection 'market', doc_id = date): spx, gex, dix, gexSign, gexDate (source: SqueezeMetrics free DIX/GEX CSV, a model estimate of S&P dealer gamma), macro = list of that day's scheduled events (jobs report, CPI, PPI, FOMC, JOLTS etc. from bls.gov and federalreserve.gov), opex (third Friday), quadWitching (third Friday of Mar/Jun/Sep/Dec), earlyClose. Backfilled once from 2026-10-06 with macro [] (calendar not compiled before Nov 23).

Known context at setup: on Nov 20 IBorrowDesk showed MSS shares available falling from 55,000 at the open to 4,000 by 10:28 New York, fee 79% -> 87%, before its 11:15 New York breakout; AKAN was on the Nasdaq Reg SHO threshold list for 2026-11-20; SqueezeMetrics GEX was +1.13bn on Nov 18, -0.90bn Nov 19, -2.16bn Nov 20 (S&P 7323.63 -> 6910.39). Nov 20 was monthly options expiry.

Caveats for testing: IBorrowDesk covers IBKR's lendable pool only; short float lags up to two weeks; GEX is an estimate and vendors differ; the Reg SHO list is about failures to deliver, not short interest. Test after 19 Dec on rows from 23 Nov onwards.
